_note: Assumptions for the Arcadia Planitia data-center site study (third region). Every value here is a scenario assumption, not data. Edit freely; then run python -m martian_map snapshot --scenario scenario/arcadia.json.
name: Arcadia Planitia data-center site study

base.note: assumption: middle of the 1 m HiRISE elevation model DTEEC_035862_2195 on the flat northern plain of Arcadia Planitia (39 N, 193 E), in the mid-latitude band where NASA's SWIM project maps ice that may be buried close to the surface. No lander or rover has been here. Placeholder until the team decides.

study.name: CTX DTM D22_035862_2182_XN_38N167W__D22_035928_2192_XN_39N167W
study.note: chosen 2026-11-15 from the USGS CTX DTMs covering the study area: 91% of the study area has heights

fine.name: HiRISE DTM DTEEC_035862_2195_035928_2195_A01
fine.note: a 1 m model on the plain; several other HiRISE models listed for Arcadia return HTTP 404 (checked 2026-11-15)

trip_area.note: assumption: 2.4 x 4.9 km box around the base and both near-base sites with a margin of about 120 m, for planning walking and rover routes (2 m elevation and slope).

sites.name: Near base, north (plain)
sites.note: assumption: 2 x 2 km candidate chosen 2026-11-15 by screening the 20 m CTX slope map inside the 1 m model, 1-3 km from the base (near edge 0.3 km, far corner 2.9 km); 94% of 20 m cells at or under 5 degrees. Moved west the same day: the 1 m model has a gap about 1 km wide east of the base, which left the first box only 68% covered.

sites.name: Near base, south (plain)
sites.note: assumption: 2 x 2 km candidate chosen 2026-11-15 the same way (near edge 0.3 km, far corner 3.1 km); 99% of 20 m cells at or under 5 degrees.

facility_footprint_m.note: not agreed; 200 x 200 m = 4 ha, the top of the 2-4 ha precinct search envelope in docs/reference-facility.md

max_construction_slope_deg.note: overall pad tilt; proposed baseline (P) in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md

max_local_pad_slope_deg.note: steepest 10 m x 10 m window on the pad; proposed baseline (P) in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md

max_roughness_m.note: placeholder only: BT-08 has no universal limit; it must come from the support design (R_allow)

vehicle_step_limit_m.note: illustration only in docs/requirements/buildable-terrain.md; not an adopted rover capability

dem_vertical_precision_m.note: used for noise floors; the USGS elevation models state no vertical precision

reference_facility.note: copied from docs/reference-facility.md (proposals, not engineering values)
